title: Volleyball: CSB completes playoff cast in Unity Cup
summary: College of Saint Benilde on Sunday completed the playoff cast of the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup after a quick victory over Mapua University at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
